# porkbun_webhook (Resource)

Manages a webhook endpoint that receives signed POST requests for account events. Porkbun disables an endpoint after 20 consecutive failed deliveries; the next apply re-enables it while `enabled` is `true`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porkbun_webhook" "example" {
  url    = "https://example.com/porkbun/webhook"
  events = ["domain.registered", "dns.*"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) The HTTPS URL that receives the signed POST. Port 443 only, and the hostname must resolve to a public internet address.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are sent. Defaults to `true`.
- `events` (Set of String) Event types to subscribe to, such as `domain.registered`. Prefix wildcards like `dns.*` are allowed. `*` means all events. Defaults to `["*"]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The webhook endpoint ID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The signing secret (HMAC-SHA256 key) used to verify the `X-Porkbun-Signature` header.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porkbun_webhook.example <webhook_id>

terraform import porkbun_webhook.example 42
```
